To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the four cellular carriers have similar infrastructure designs and that they all have a single DNS authoritative server, which is located at the edge of their networks, and a single BGP routing policy.
the cellular network infrastructure in the U.S. is highly centralized, and that there exist several hotspots of cellular data traffic.

the cellular network infrastructures are highly heterogeneous in terms of the number of DNS servers, the number of DNS authoritative servers, the number and the size of the routing domains, the number of ASs, the number of IP address ranges, the number and types of the network devices, and the number of the network interfaces.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following two questions. (i) What is the cellular network infrastructure like? and (ii) What are the implications of the infrastructure on the content placement for mobile users?
the following questions: (a) What are the network topology and routing design of cellular carriers? (b) How is the address space allocated in cellular networks?
the following three aspects.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the cellular data networks of all the four carriers are not designed as a unified, homogeneous network infrastructure.
the cellular infrastructure in the U.S. is very diverse and complex.
the infrastructure of the cellular data network is not homogeneous, i.e., it is carrier specific, but it is rather consistent within each carrier.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

(i) the cellular data network infrastructures are quite diverse, (ii) the network topology of the cellular data network is significantly different from the Internet backbone network topology, and (iii) the DNS configuration and address allocation of cellular data network infrastructure is quite unique.
the cellular network infrastructure is not as homogeneous and static as we expected.

we can discover a large number of cellular network infrastructure components, such as DNS servers, IP addresses, ASes, and routers, and that we can infer the network topology and routing design of the cellular data network, as well as the relationship among various components.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the cellular network infrastructure can be discovered with high accuracy and reliability.
cellular network operators use a wide range of techniques to optimize their infrastructure.
the network infrastructure of cellular carriers is very different from that of the Internet, which poses new challenges for content delivery to the growing population.
